caption: The drawing depicts a single light beige or cream-colored flat shoe shown in profile view, occupying the lower center of the composition. The shoe has a low, short heel and features a small decorative bow on the upper front, just above the toes. The toe area of the shoe is adorned with a floral embroidery pattern in muted shades of green, pink, and yellow. Parallel stitching details are visible near the instep. Above the profile view of the shoe, two outlines of the shoe viewed from above are lightly sketched, showing the arrangement and construction of the upper part of the shoe but without color or additional detail. The entire composition is set against a uniform grayish-green background with a simple pale border.
title: Woman's Slipper
